templates.template:
<xf:macro id="type_options" arg-question="!"> <xf:comment> The options a forum user question has of its own, in the question editor. They follow the vendor Text branch of snog_forms_question_edit_macros::question_types, keeping placeholder and default answer and leaving out regex, length limits and expected answers, which do nothing for these types. The vendor save maps fields to columns only for its own types, so Cav7\FormsUserQuestion\Snog\Forms\Admin\Controller\Questions saves these two, under field names of the addon's own. </xf:comment> <xf:textboxrow name="cav7_fuq_placeholder" value="{$question.placeholder}" maxlength="{{ max_length($question, 'placeholder') }}" label="{{ phrase('snog_forms_placeholder') }}" explain="{{ phrase('cav7_fuq_placeholder_explain') }}" />
<xf:textboxrow name="cav7_fuq_default_answer" value="{$question.defanswer}" maxlength="{{ max_length($question, 'defanswer') }}" label="{{ phrase('snog_forms_default_answer') }}" explain="{{ phrase('cav7_fuq_default_answer_explain') }}" /> </xf:macro>

The box a forum user question is answered in. It copies the vendor's type_text macro in snog_forms_question_macros, less its maxlength and minlength. Those read type_data, which a question converted from Text keeps, so the browser would go on enforcing a limit the server no longer applies. {$formData|raw}
